description: This Java source file defines an abstract utility class StatusCodeMapper that provides static methods for mapping HTTP and AMQP status codes and error conditions to custom ServiceInvocationException instances. It includes methods to check success status, create exceptions based on request or registration results, status codes, and AMQP error conditions.

classes.name: StatusCodeMapper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to convert HTTP and AMQP status codes and error conditions into ServiceInvocationException instances.

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Checks if a given status code represents a successful invocation (HTTP 200-299).

methods.name: from (RequestResponseResult<?>)
methods.description: Creates a ServiceInvocationException from a service invocation result.

methods.name: from (RegistrationResult)
methods.description: Creates a ServiceInvocationException from a registration result, extracting error payload if available.

methods.name: from (int, String)
methods.description: Creates an appropriate ServiceInvocationException based on HTTP status code and optional detail message.

methods.name: from (ErrorCondition)
methods.description: Creates a ServiceInvocationException from an AMQP ErrorCondition.

methods.name: from (Symbol, String)
methods.description: Creates a ServiceInvocationException from an AMQP Symbol condition and description.
